get.description:
OpenAPI document the console's types will be generated from (via orval).

Public on purpose: it describes API shapes but serves no flag data. The
management API operations it documents remain session-authenticated.

parameters.name: v
parameters.description: Ensaio implements only PostHog's version 2 response shape.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Bearer token using the team's ens_sec_ definitions secret.
